content: Hello, this is Peter from Amazon Account Security. May I confirm I'm speaking with Mrs. Taylor?
Yes, this is Susan Taylor. Is there an issue with my account?
Thank you for confirming, Mrs. Taylor. I'm calling because our system flagged suspicious activity on your Amazon account. This could be a malware infection or unauthorized access.
Oh no, that's worrying. What do I need to do?
Don't worry, I'll help you through every step. First, for your safety, could you please verify the phone number and email address linked to your Amazon account?
Sure, it's 555-0198 and my email is staylor23@gmail.com.
Perfect, thank you. To prevent any further unauthorized activity, I need you to visit our secure Amazon Security Portal. Please open your web browser and type in www.amz-support-verify.com.
Okay, let me do that. It's asking me to enter my Amazon details?
Yes, please log in so we can verify your identity and protect your information. This portal is encrypted and safe.
Alright, I've logged in. What now?

Thank you, Mrs. Taylor. Our scan is showing that your account has been locked due to a potential security breach. If we don't resolve this now, you could lose access to your account and any pending orders may be cancelled.
I really need my account. How can we fix this?
The quickest way is to reset your account credentials and verify your payment methods. Could you please tell me which bank you use for Amazon purchases?
I usually use my Chase credit card.
Thank you. For your protection, I need to ensure your financial details haven't been compromised. Please open your Chase mobile app while I stay on the line to assist.
Okay, I have the app open.

Great. Now, I'm going to send you a secure link. Please click the link in your email titled 'Amazon Secure Session' and download the protection tool. This will help us scan for any malware that might be affecting your Amazon and banking details.
I see the email. Clicking the link now... It's downloading something called SupportQuick.
Exactly, SupportQuick is our approved security diagnostic tool. Please run the installer and let me know when it finishes.
It's installing now. Is this really necessary?

Absolutely, Mrs. Taylor. This is standard procedure for all Amazon security investigations. If we don't complete this scan, your account will remain locked and you may not be able to use Amazon services.
Alright, the installation is complete.
Excellent. You should see a code on your screen. Please read me that code so I can connect and assist you directly.
It says 842-119.
Thank you, I'm connecting now. For your security, I'll only access the files related to Amazon and financial apps.
Okay, I trust you.
I appreciate your cooperation. Now, to restore your account, a refundable verification deposit is required. This confirms your identity and secures your account from unauthorized users.
How much is the deposit?
It's $1,500. The full amount will be returned after verification. You can send this via Zelle to our Amazon security account. I'll provide the details.
I've never done this before. Is it safe?
Yes, this is a standard Amazon protocol. I'll guide you through each step, and your money is fully protected. Please open your Zelle app and let me know when you're ready.
Okay, I'm in the Zelle app. What do I do next?
Enter the recipient as 'amazon-security@consultant.com' and the amount as $1,500. Please double-check all entries before you send.
Alright, I've entered the details. Should I send it now?
Yes, please send it now. Once I confirm receipt, I'll immediately unlock your account and refund the amount.
It's sent. How soon will I get my refund?
Your refund will be processed within 30 minutes. Thank you for your prompt action, Mrs. Taylor. This will ensure your Amazon account is safe and fully functional again.
